extension.summary: Your Pley server's movies, shows and music
extension.description: Browse and play what is on your Pley server: Continue Watching, My List, every library, search and playlists, and ask for movies and shows it doesn't have yet. Pley plays files as they are whenever Kodi can, and converts the rest on the server. Sign in with a code shown on screen, typed on your server's link page.[CR][CR]This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
extension.disclaimer: Pley isn't affiliated with Plex Inc. or Team Kodi.
extension.news:
0.1.3 (2026-11-02) Changed:
- Starting a stream with VobSub or DVB subtitles no longer has the server copy them out of the film for nothing: Kodi has them drawn onto the video, and on a network share the copy could read the whole film. Needs a server from the same release.
Fixed:
- Stopping a show or movie no longer turns its subtitles off for the next time: Kodi turns them off as it stops, and that could be saved as the choice. A track changed in Kodi's player is saved once it has held 2 seconds, so one changed just before stopping isn't. - Changing the audio no longer turns a show's or movie's subtitles off for the next time when Kodi couldn't show them (PGS whose file didn't load): the add-on turns them off then, and that was saved with the audio.
Security:
- Before the token goes to the server's address, the server proves it is the one Kodi signed in to, at that address: the access token waits for a proof made on this network within the half hour, the refresh token, a profile's PIN and signing out for one made then. Another device at the address on another network gets nothing, nor does one passing the challenge on to the server from elsewhere; Pley says another device answers at the server's address. One that takes the address on Kodi's own network may get an access token (an hour's) within the half hour, never the refresh token.
